description: Specify whether or not gridpoint stiffnesses are accumulated across zone joints. By default, only the contact model stiffness is accumulated to gridpoints on either side of a zone joint. If activated, both the contact model stiffness and the gridpoint stiffnesses are accumulated to gridpoints on either side of a zone joint. This may be useful when sliver zones exist with zone joints, providing a substantially higher degree of stability. This command should be given before cycling the model, and only for models with sliver zones.
notes: Documented in the 'wad' (wall-and-discontinuity) doc tree, not under flac3d/ -- which is why this family is absent from the FLAC zone corpus.
Live-probed on MPoint3D 9.7 (2026-09-14). Availability in FLAC3D is unverified.
